days.title: Peaks and Northern Interpretation
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: pico de Guara
stops.detail: Its altitude levels range from 430 meters at the Alcanadre river to 2,077 at the Guara peak.

stops.name: barrancos del río Balcés
stops.detail: It is worth noting, for their spectacular nature, the canyons of the Balcés River, with their more than 20 km in length and drops exceeding 800 m, as well as the Grallera Alta de Guara chasm, with a 277 m vertical drop.

days.title: Ancient History and Nature

stops.name: cueva de Chaves
stops.detail: The Chaves cave, in Bastarás, in the municipality of Casbas de Huesca, housed one of the most important Neolithic sites on the Iberian Peninsula before being destroyed.

stops.name: Fuente del Trucho
stops.detail: There are Upper Paleolithic cave paintings at the Fuente del Trucho.
